findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_customer_vat_id, check_iban, check_invoice_recipient_vat_id, check_vat_id, list_invoice_templates, verify_webhook_signature · Private data: convert_sales_document, create_sales_document, create_webhook, delete_sales_document, download_sales_document_pdf, get_sales_document, list_sales_documents, merge_sales_documents, record_payment, update_sales_document, update_sales_document_status, verify_webhook_signature · Public sink: cancel_invoice, check_vat_id, create_webhook, delete_invoice_draft, delete_webhook, download_invoice_zugferd, get_webhook, list_invoice_templates, list_webhooks, send_webhook_test, update_invoice_status, update_sales_document, verify_webhook_signature · Destructive: delete_customer, delete_invoice_draft, delete_sales_document, delete_webhook, download_invoice_xrechnung, export_datev, export_datev_creditors, get_invoice_girocode.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_customer_vat_id, check_iban, check_invoice_recipient_vat_id, check_vat_id, list_invoice_templates, verify_webhook_signature · Private data: convert_sales_document, create_sales_document, create_webhook, delete_sales_document, download_sales_document_pdf, get_sales_document, list_sales_documents, merge_sales_documents, record_payment, update_sales_document, update_sales_document_status, verify_webhook_signature · Public sink: cancel_invoice, check_vat_id, create_webhook, delete_invoice_draft, delete_webhook, download_invoice_zugferd, get_webhook, list_invoice_templates, list_webhooks, send_webhook_test, update_invoice_status, update_sales_document, verify_webhook_signature · Destructive: delete_customer, delete_invoice_draft, delete_sales_document, delete_webhook, download_invoice_xrechnung, export_datev, export_datev_creditors, get_invoice_girocode

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
